cues.en: Instructor: So here we are with an unsupervised learning project.
cues.zh: 講師：這裡是無監督學習專案。

cues.en: In fact, there's going to be two unsupervised learning projects with k-means clustering.
cues.zh: K-means 分群其實會有兩個專案。

cues.en: So the first one, which is the goal of this video, is to explore the importance of normalization on the resulting clusters.
cues.zh: 第一個，也就是這支影片的目標，是探索正規化對分群結果的重要性。

cues.en: So you can see that both of these axis have basically the same scale, and all the data kind of fall into the same scale, the same normalization.
cues.zh: 兩條軸基本上尺度相同，所有資料大致處在相同尺度、相同正規化。

cues.en: Now, that is pretty much guaranteed by how I simulated the data here using random numbers.
cues.zh: 用隨機數模擬的方式，幾乎保證如此。

cues.en: So what I want you to do in this video is explore the role of normalization, the importance of normalization.
cues.zh: 現在要探索正規化的角色與重要性。

cues.en: The way that you're going to do that is by expanding one of these axis.
cues.zh: 方法是拉大其中一條軸。

cues.en: So maybe, you know, you can blow up axis to the Y axis so that the data, instead of being clustered as a ball,
cues.zh: 例如放大 Y 軸，讓資料不再像這樣聚成球形，

cues.en: like this, is clustered more as an oval.
So, on axis one, you have the same amount of blur, which is going to be, you know, one.
cues.zh: 第一軸保留相同模糊程度，例如 1。

cues.en: And on the, on the Y axis, maybe you have a blur factor of, I don't know, three or five or 10, you can play around.
cues.zh: Y 軸的模糊因子則可能是 3、5 或 10，可以試試。

cues.en: And you might want to, actually, to make sure that this is, you're getting the right message from this project, you might want to decrease the blur here
cues.zh: 為確保從專案得到正確訊息，也可能要先減少這裡的模糊程度，

cues.en: to make these clusters tighter to make it even more obvious that there really are three clusters.
cues.zh: 讓群集更緊密，更明顯看出確實有三群。

cues.en: And then, basically explore expanding one of the dimensions so that these look more like ovals and less like circles.
cues.zh: 再拉大其中一維，讓它更像橢圓，而非圓。

cues.en: So, modify the code to get that to work and see if you can make some really great discoveries about k-means clustering.
cues.zh: 修改程式使它運作，看看能否發現 K-means 的一些有趣特性。

cues.en: And if you find something really important, if you make a a really great discovery, feel free to post to the Q&A form.
cues.zh: 如果有重要、精彩的發現，歡迎貼到問答區。
